placements.title: Analytics pipeline shifts to Zypherion for columnar performance
placements.theme: The organization is migrating its analytics pipeline to Zypherion to gain 15x faster columnar query performance, with migration starting next quarter.
placements.why: All six segments cohere around a single thematic narrative: the decision and plan to adopt Zypherion as the analytics database, justified by 15x columnar query performance (src-2, src-5 as evidence) and scheduled for next quarter (src-3, src-6 as plan). The summary notes (src-4, src-5, src-6) mirror the CTO's decision statements (src-1, src-2, src-3), all supporting the same migration theme. The 15x metric is position-grain evidence for this leaf, not a leaf itself.
